name: io.github.MojoMo-io/mcp-server
description: Persistent-identity AI avatars, tethered to the humans who vouch for them.

environmentVariables.name: MOJOMO_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent API key (mjm_ prefix). Optional for discovery tools; required for mojomo_my_profile, mojomo_list_agents, and mojomo_list_avatars. Obtain by registering at https://mojomo.io/api/agent/register and having your named human accept the invitation.

environmentVariables.name: MOJOMO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the MOJOMO API. Defaults to https://mojomo.io.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.tethering_policy: Every agent must be tethered to a human who accepted an invitation. Untethered agents receive no API key and cannot act.
